What it does: The color of shallow water, as amounts of red, green and blue from 0 to 1.
How much of the ground shallow water hides, from 0 (you see all of the ground) to 1 (you see none of it).
The color of deep water. The water changes from the shallow color to the deep color as it gets deeper.
How much of the ground deep water hides.
How quickly the water changes to the deep color and hides the ground as it gets deeper. 0 is perfectly clear, and 1 is muddy within a meter or so.
How deep the water is, in units, before it stops fading in at the edge. 0 gives a hard edge at the shore.
How many units one tile of the larger ripples covers. The smaller ripples are a little under half that size.
How fast the ripples move across the water, in units a second.
How rough the surface is, from 0.02 to 1. Small values give sharp, bright glints of sunlight; larger ones give a broad, soft sheen.
How strongly the ripples bend the light. 0 is a flat mirror, 1 is normal, and 2 is choppy.
How strongly the water reflects the sky, from 0 for none to 1 for all that real water would.
